verdict.rationale: Sumsub offers RESTful APIs, WebSDK, mobile SDKs, and a React package, plus a dedicated MCP server for AI agents to perform Sumsub operations, showing agentic/AI-native building blocks. However, there's no evidence of dedicated official SDKs for popular languages (Python, Node, Java, etc.) beyond WebSDK/React, and no OpenAPI spec was found (404s), limiting confidence in broad official SDK coverage. missing for 10: official multi-language backend SDKs (Python/Node/Java/etc.), a published OpenAPI/swagger spec, independent developer corroboration of SDK quality.
